pizzaWeight.title: Pizza weight
pizzaWeight.helperText: Value in grams. A value between 250 and 280 is recommended (~30cm).

saltRatio.title: Salt ratio
saltRatio.helperText: Value as % of total flour. A value between 2.8 and 3.2 is recommended.

honeyRatio.title: Honey ratio
honeyRatio.helperText: Value as % of total flour. A value between 0 and 0.5 is recommended.
